usage: ppgrid [-h] [--version] [--value-col VALUE_COL] [--lng-col LNG_COL]
              [--lat-col LAT_COL] [--src-crs SRC_CRS] [--work-crs WORK_CRS]
              [--out-crs OUT_CRS] [--res METRES] [--cap-km KM] [--block CELLS]
              [--transform {auto,identity,log10,sqrt,percentile}]
              [--saturation SATURATION] [--scale SCALE]
              [--percentile-step PERCENTILE_STEP] [--skip-calibration]
              [--seed SEED] [--calib-max-points CALIB_MAX_POINTS]
              [--calibration CALIBRATION] [--workers WORKERS]
              [--max-band-parallel MAX_BAND_PARALLEL] [--turbo [GB]]
              [--max-ram GB] [--ram-gb GB] [--turbo-strict] [-o OUT]
              [--compress COMPRESS] [--force] [--json] [--plan] [--quiet]
              [--color {auto,always,never}] [--verbose]
              [--log-level {error,warning,info,debug}] [--log-file PATH]
              [--config PATH]
              [input]

Pull-push scattered-data interpolation Read-only subcommands (they write no output files): `ppgrid doctor` (stack health), `ppgrid probe INPUT` (input diagnostic), `ppgrid list-crs` (CRS codes). `ppgrid doctor --help` etc. for detail.

positional arguments:
  input                 CSV or Parquet input path

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --version             show program's version number and exit

input/columns:
  --value-col VALUE_COL
                        Value column name (default: value)
  --lng-col LNG_COL     Longitude column name (default: longitude)
  --lat-col LAT_COL     Latitude column name (default: latitude)

CRS/grid:
  --src-crs SRC_CRS     Input CRS as a bare int or 'EPSG:<code>' string
                        (default: 4326)
  --work-crs WORK_CRS   Working CRS for interpolation, bare int or
                        'EPSG:<code>' (default: 6933)
  --out-crs OUT_CRS     Output CRS, bare int or 'EPSG:<code>' (default: 3857)
  --res METRES          Cell size in metres (default: 500)
  --cap-km KM           Fill cap in km, or 'auto' (default: auto)
  --block CELLS         Block size in cells (default: 2048)

interpolation:
  --transform {auto,identity,log10,sqrt,percentile}
                        Value transform for the interpolation (default: auto)
  --saturation SATURATION
                        Point counts for a cell to fully self-trust (default:
                        1)
  --scale SCALE         DN = percentile * scale (default: 100)
  --percentile-step PERCENTILE_STEP
                        Round output percentiles to the nearest step (e.g. 5
                        -> 90/95/100) (default: off)
  --skip-calibration    Skip calibration, use defaults
  --seed SEED           RNG seed for the calibration subsampling and blocked-
                        CV bootstrap (default: 0; same seed + same input ->
                        reproducible outputs)
  --calib-max-points CALIB_MAX_POINTS
                        Max points used for the calibration subsampling
                        (default: 2000000)
  --calibration CALIBRATION
                        Calibration JSON path (default: none)

memory/turbo:
  --workers WORKERS     Number of workers (positive integer, or 'auto' =
                        os.cpu_count()) (default: 4)
  --max-band-parallel MAX_BAND_PARALLEL
                        Cap parallel row-band workers for the low-RAM shared
                        descent (default: --workers).
  --turbo [GB]          Turbo mode: parallel phases sized to a RAM budget.
                        Optional RAM cap preset 16|32|64|128 (GB, decimal 1e9
                        bytes); bare --turbo = auto-detect. Presets are common
                        sizes; use --max-ram GB for any value.
  --max-ram GB          Explicit RAM cap in GB (decimal, 1e9 bytes; overrides
                        the --turbo preset). Implies --turbo.
  --ram-gb GB           Alias of --max-ram.
  --turbo-strict        Shared path infeasible under the budget: error + exit
                        3 instead of [warn] + per-box fallback (exit 0).

output:
  -o, --out OUT         Output directory (default: out/)
  --compress COMPRESS   GeoTIFF tile compression codec (default: ZSTD)
  --force               Overwrite existing outputs in the out dir (default:
                        exit 2 when value.tif / support_km.tif /
                        calibration.json / run_summary.json are already
                        present)
  --json                Write a machine-readable run summary to
                        <out>/run_summary.json (phase timings, volumetrics,
                        grid, calibration, CLI params; stdout stays clean)
  --plan                Resolve the full run plan, print it, and exit 0 before
                        running; creates no files or directories

logging:
  --quiet, -q           Suppress stderr below WARNING (beats --verbose and
                        LOGGING; an explicit --log-level wins)
  --color {auto,always,never}
                        Color output: auto (TTY, no NO_COLOR/TERM=dumb),
                        always, never. Live progress needs a TTY stderr plus
                        --color auto/always and no --quiet.
  --verbose             Debug logging: per-phase wall times + volumetric
                        detail (shorthand for --log-level debug)
  --log-level {error,warning,info,debug}
                        Progress log level on stderr (default: info; env
                        LOGGING; 'verbose' = debug)
  --log-file PATH       Also write the run log to this file: created fresh
                        each run, level info, same unified format as stderr
                        (no color); stderr output is unchanged

config:
  --config PATH         Pipeline options file, TOML (default: discover
                        ./ppgrid.toml, then ~/.config/ppgrid/ppgrid.toml;
                        `ppgrid init` writes a commented template; precedence:
                        CLI flag > config > built-in default)

examples:
  # Basic run: 10 km cells, auto transform and fill cap, default 4 workers
  ppgrid data/melb_houses.csv -o out/melb_10km --res 10000 --value-col price

  # Custom transform, CRS and DN scale: log10 values, WGS84 output, DN = 10*percentile
  ppgrid data/all_equakes.csv -o out/eq --transform log10 --out-crs 4326 --scale 10 --cap-km 20 --value-col mag

  # Turbo: 32 GB RAM budget, strict (exit 3 if infeasible), 8 workers.
  ppgrid data/melb_houses.csv -o out/melb_turbo --turbo 32 --turbo-strict --workers 8 --value-col price

progress logging:
  Progress goes to stderr (stdout stays clean). Default level is info (one line
  per phase + a final summary). --verbose (or --log-level debug, or
  LOGGING=verbose) adds a per-phase wall-time
  breakdown and volumetric detail (rows read, NaN/inf dropped, cells per level,
  output bytes raw vs compressed, resolved plan).

exit codes:
  0  ok (also: `ppgrid help` and `--plan`)
  1  pipeline / I/O error (bad output path, missing input file, disk full)
  2  validation error (bad flag value, missing input column, out dir not
     empty without --force)
  3  --turbo-strict: shared path infeasible under the RAM budget
  130 interrupted (SIGINT): one `interrupted` line, no traceback; run
      temp files removed (retained partials named), earlier run's rasters
      warned as stale

Run `ppgrid help` to print this text at any time.
